■Direction
1 second of silence at the start
If you wait patiently, the flowers truly do bloom, don't they?

It is decided, then.
Trainer, would you care to go to the festival tonight~?

Her leisurely, soothing voice slowly seeped into my body,
which had apparently grown exhausted without me even realizing it.
...You know, Trainer. As I thought—

The sea! The blue sky! Summer training camp! Faced with this
essential chance for growth, I'm feeling even more fired up than usual...!

After this, I'll let Mejiro Bright rest while I rework the practice schedule.
Then it's into the ocean for strength training.

It seems quite a few stalls have already closed up, but~...
They do say, "Good fortune comes to those who wait for the leftovers."

The staff back at the camp mentioned it, you see~.
Apparently, there is a festival nearby starting this evening.

"I still have other things I need to do, though..."
Even as I protest, I take a seat, and Mejiro Bright smiles gently.

There is truly no need to thank me~.
In the end, all I did was take things slow and easy as always, after all.

Mejiro Bright was her usual leisurely self,
but she seemed to be enjoying it, and the training was going smoothly.

What reached my ears amidst the drowsiness was a gentle singing voice.
A slow, comforting sound, like a lullaby heard once long ago.

The documents I had to submit, the festival we planned to attend—
While I double-check the schedule, Mejiro Bright leisurely speaks up.

My goodness~!! Tee-hee~.
It is shaped just like a flower, isn't it?
My, sorting through your documents with such efficiency~...

My, what a lovely leftover prize~.
Tee-hee, well then, if you will excuse me—

Now, now, you just got back, did you not?
There are so very many things I wish to chat about today~.

Having arrived long after everyone else, the festival grounds
were indeed quiet, and the crowds seemed to be thinning out.

If I want to enjoy the festival with her, I have to finish the rest of my work!
First, let's start by reorganizing the training schedule!

Our own pace...
You mean, yours and mine, Trainer?

During the break, I went exploring the rocky shore with Dober.
And then, we found a purple sea slug~—

...Indeed... yes. In the end, taking things easy
and being a "slowpoke" suits me best of all, doesn't it~?

The documents... you mean the ones to hand over to the camp staff, yes?
When I asked if tomorrow would be fine~, they said it was no problem at all.

My, off they go. A break is all well and good, but
I wonder if Trainer will properly get some rest as well~?

I really might have been pushing myself a bit too hard...
Thanks to her letting me sleep, I can feel my energy returning.
Hmm-hmm-hmmm... hmm-hmm-hmm, hm-hm-hmmm♪
...All right. I shall give it my very best~.

I scramble to sit up.
I must have fallen asleep on the lobby sofa without even realizing it...!

I simply thought there was no need to rush off to the festival~.
After all, there is always next year, isn't there~?
...*Staaare*.
Oh no, weren't there still documents I needed to put together—

...Did I overdo it just a little bit~?
I ended up changing your plans and all, Trainer.
Hyah~...!
Well then, I leave the timekeeping in your capable hands~.

Ages ago, silly~.
Is something the matter? You seemed to be daydreaming, though.

If she hadn't let me take it easy like this,
there's a good chance I would have been too exhausted to even make it to the festival.

It sounds like many of the other Umamusume are going too.
So today, let us take our sweet time—

Such lovely weather~, it makes me want to take a nap on the beach.
Now then, we have just one more run left, do we not~?

...Come to think of it, Trainer. You were staying up late last night,
prepping all those nutritional drinks for me, were you not~?

Hey there, little lady! Care to try the raffle?
There's only one ticket left, and I'd love to sell out for the night.
And then, after that—

Splendid! We have a grand prize winner!
Here's your prize. A brooch that's just perfect for a lovely lady like you!
Hmm~, hmm-hmm-hmm, hm-hm-hmmm♪

My... are you awake already?
You were more than welcome to rest for a bit longer, you know.
Traaaiineeer~!

Tee-hee, feeling sleepy now, are we?
Please, do not hesitate to drift off and sleep as lo~ng as you like~.

...iner?
...Trainer?

The thunderhead clouds bigger than mountains were floating
and melting away like soft-serve ice cream, you see~...

Even after that, the two of us enjoyed the winding-down festival.
Slowly, leisurely... preserving a pace that was entirely our own.

My, welcome back~.
Come, come. Please, have a seat right next to me.

Oh my~, look over there, Trainer.
It appears that grilled carrot stall is still open for business.

After taking care of various chores and finishing the route inspection
of the forest trail for tomorrow's practice, the sun had already long begun to set.

Out in the open water, jellyfish were gently drifting along.
I was gazing out at them lazily from the shore, you see~.
